Lily has practiced football for three years and won a prize last term. On Friday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Time-blocking tames a chaotic diary.

People around Lily often share different ideas about the work station. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What's more, final sale items cannot be returned.
Little by little, things began to change. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. Lily thanked Anna for the honest advice. She volunteers for the night shift.

The experience taught Lily more than any book could. The work station looked quieter than usual that evening. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Hybrid working pairs office days with home days.
The training center has become an important part of daily life. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily plans to study art harder this term.
